points: Moav comes from Lot and his daughters and from Sedom, and they were not kind to us when we left Mitzrayim.
Yirmiyahu doesn't criticize Moav for being unkind. He criticizes them for being too comfortable, like a drunk who keeps drinking until he falls apart.
The lesson for us: the Jewish people handle poverty well, but wealth and comfort can lead us astray.
Rav Saadiah Gaon says Hashem and the navi really mourn Moav: each nation carries a positive trait, and when it is wiped out, that is lost too.
So many cities of Moav are named because they were our next-door neighbors. The closer to home the message, the more it hits, like hearing about Canada instead of France.
